name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.44.0: operator-wide screen posters. Posters set on an operator show on every machine of that operator; a machine with posters of its own shows those instead. GET/PUT /api/v1/operators/:id/ads and POST .../ads/upload; saving bumps every machine of the operator so the 304-on-configVersion config is re-fetched. The config gains adsSource (machine | operator | none). In the dashboard the edit-operator dialog gets a posters section, and a machine with no posters says when it is showing its operator's. Cumulative over v6.43.0.
